name: 테슬라 코일(둥근 받침 + 구리 감은 탑 + 놋쇠 고리 + 구 + 불꽃)
label: steampunk-city/sp-tesla-coil

answer.main_body: copper coil tower with brass ring and sphere terminal
answer.evidence: The copper coil column is drawn as a flat cylinder with completely straight horizontal stripe windings (no curvature from the 45-degree angle). The top sphere/terminal also terminates in a flat 1px horizontal line at row 4 with no visible top surface. The only foreshortened surface is on the bottom plinth, which cannot be credited.

answer.main_body: Tesla coil tower with toroid ring and base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring is clearly drawn in 3/4 top-down perspective, revealing its horizontal annular surface and central opening (rows 13-16) with the column passing through. The base also displays a foreshortened top surface (rows 38-40).

answer.main_body: Tesla coil tower with copper windings, brass toroid ring, top sphere, and base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring (rows 12-18) clearly shows a 3/4 top-down perspective with a foreshortened ellipse opening (rows 13-16, 4 rows tall) viewed from above, and the base (rows 38-40) also shows a visible top shelf.

answer.main_body: tesla coil tower with copper-wound shaft, brass toroid ring, top terminal sphere, and cylindrical base
answer.evidence: The brass toroid ring at rows 12-17 clearly shows an elliptical top surface looking down into the ring hole (rows 13-16), and the cylindrical pedestal base shows its top surface foreshortened at rows 38-41.
